title: Code editor
content: MatxCodeEditor is a simple code editor. It can format incoming data and validate edits, showing a message when the current text is invalid.

title: Code editor
content: Edit the JSON. Valid changes update the status; invalid JSON displays a warning.

title: Code editor
content: Import CodeEditor and provide the initial text. A validator can be used to show feedback and emit only valid edits:

title: Code editor
content: validChange is debounced by 200 ms and emits only when a validator is provided and the edited value is valid. Invalid edits display the validator's message.

title: Code editor
content: data supplies the initial or updated editor content. When data changes, formatter can format it before it appears in the editor. disabled prevents editing. validator checks edits and provides the warning message for invalid text.

title: Code editor
content: validChange emits valid edited content when a validator is provided. It is debounced by 200 ms. Use getData() through a ViewChild query to read the current editor content at any time.

title: Editor app
content: provides a file explorer, editor tabs, and file operations for an application-specific editor. It manages file contents as strings and uses the conversion functions to translate between those strings and your editor's data model T. The actual editor UI is supplied by your application through content projection.

title: Explorer
content: MatxExplorer displays files in a tree and provides operations to open, save, rename, and delete them. It uses an IFileService implementation to access files; choose a built-in provider or supply your own.

title: Explorer
content: Explore and select the sample files. The demo stores files temporarily; they are cleared when the page is reloaded.

title: Explorer
content: For browser-only projects, provide the local-storage implementation:

title: Explorer
content: provideLocalStorageExplorer accepts a storage-key prefix, defaulting to matx_explorer_. For an HTTP-backed file service, provide provideExplorer(fileServiceUrl) and configure Angular HttpClient in your application. The service expects endpoints for listing, loading, saving, renaming, and deleting files; implement IFileService to use another backend. For temporary in-memory storage, use provideTemporaryStorageExplorer(). Its files are cleared when the application is reloaded.

title: Explorer
content: extension filters files and is used for operations, without a leading dot. An empty value leaves filenames unchanged. selectedFile sets the selected filename. fileClick emits the selected filename; filesLoaded emits the number of files after loading or refreshing the listing.

title: Explorer
content: With extension="json", the explorer displays names without .json and appends .json when accessing files through its service.

title: Explorer

title: Explorer
content: File operations return RxJS observables. A file is represented by { filename: string, content: string }; File and IFileService are exported from @grumptech/ngx-matx/explorer.

title: Full width form fields
content: MatxFullWidthFormFields is a content wrapper that makes Angular Material mat-form-field elements inside it span the full available width.

title: Full width form fields
content: Both form fields expand to fill the available width.

title: Full width form fields
content: Import the standalone component and wrap the fields you want to expand:

title: Full width form fields
content: MatxFullWidthFormFields has no inputs or outputs. It sets contained mat-form-field elements to full width. Include the relevant Angular Material form-field and input modules in your component or application as usual.

title: Menu bar
content: renders top-level menus with nested items, icons, and keyboard shortcuts. It emits the selected item so your application can run the corresponding action.

title: Menu bar
content: Use the File menu or the displayed keyboard shortcuts to trigger an action.

title: Menu bar
content: Each top-level MenuBarItem has text and children. A MenuItem

title: Menu bar
content: can contain text, an optional Material icon name, nested children, shortcut definitions, and (when using a data type) an action data value.

title: Menu bar
content: Specify keyCode using KeyboardEvent.code values, such as KeyS or Delete. Modifier keys are optional:

title: Menu bar
content: ctrl, alt, and shift specify required modifier keys. keyCode uses a KeyboardEvent.code value; disabled prevents activation and hideMenuText hides the shortcut label without disabling it. Shortcuts activate the matching item and emit itemClick. Common text-editing shortcuts are left to the browser when the focus is in an input or textarea.

title: Overflow tooltip
content: MatxOverflowTooltip shows a Material tooltip only when the host element's text overflows its available width. It observes the element's size and updates the tooltip state when the element is resized.

title: Overflow tooltip

title: Panel
content: MatxPanel wraps content in an Angular Material card with an optional title and a content area. Use MatxPanelHeaderButton to place icon buttons in the header.

title: Panel

title: Panel
content: MatxPanel projects its regular children into the body and matx-panel-header-button children into the header. Its title automatically uses the overflow tooltip when it does not fit.

title: Panel

title: Panel
content: icon is a Material icon name; tooltip is shown for the button. selected applies the selected visual style and disabled disables the button. The header button has no component outputs; handle its native click event.

title: Thin scrollbars
content: The thin-scrollbars SCSS mixin adds a 6 px scrollbar with a rounded thumb and track, and hides the scrollbar corner. It also sets overflow: auto, so the element scrolls only when its content overflows.

title: Thin scrollbars
content: The code sample overflows in both directions. Scroll it to see the styled bars.

title: Thin scrollbars
content: Include the mixin in the stylesheet of the element that should scroll:

title: Thin scrollbars
content: The scrollbars mixin sets overflow: auto, a 6 px scrollbar width and height, rounded thumb and track, and hides the scrollbar corner. The custom thumb, track, and corner styles use WebKit scrollbar selectors; other browsers retain their native scrollbar appearance.
